description:
The Clear node takes in a Collection and removes all elements from the collection when called.

Known compatible types: any collection that is not read only

Known incompatible types: any collection that is read only

fields.* ([[Impulses|Call]]): Calls an impulse to remove all elements from the collection.
fields.* ([[Type:IList|IList]]): The collection to remove all elements from.
fields.OnCleared: Fires when successfully clearing out the collection.
fields.OnFail: Fires when the collection could not be cleared.
